title: Local data with SQLite

spans.text: sqlite3 stores structured data for small apps without a separate server. Parameterize queries and use a transaction when several changes must succeed together.

spans.code:
import sqlite3

with sqlite3.connect('app.db') as db:
    db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (text TEXT)')
    db.execute('INSERT INTO notes VALUES (?)', ('Hello',))
No console output; creates the table if needed and inserts one row.

spans.text: SQLite parameters keep data separate from SQL syntax.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Do not concatenate user input into SQL; pass values as parameters.

spans.title: Warning
spans.text: Formatting user values into SQL creates injection risk; use placeholders.
